topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class, reviews previous practical work, and outlines the main learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Tumour virology and assays for cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming tumour viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and how experimental assays assess cellular transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and classifications of oncogenes and tumour suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer-associated mutations and illustrate their mechanistic effects on cell cycle checkpoints and protein function.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the causes of sequence and chromosomal instability arising from defective DNA repair pathways, replication errors, and mitotic defects.

topics.label: Multistep progression, hereditary cancer syndromes, and tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the accumulation and inheritance of genetic defects drive multistep tumor progression and evolutionary adaptation.

topics.label: Conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, suggests supplementary reading, and previews the next lecture topic.
